title: Perfect VFX Edit Decision Spec
description: Single source of truth for one Perfect VFX run. The Director writes it, every render mode reads it. Nothing renders that is not in this file.

project.description: Project folder name, usually derived from the source clip's parent project folder

customBrief.description: For segmentType custom: the user's describe-what-you-want sentence. Sets emphasis only; all Director rules still apply.

createdAt.description: ISO date of the Director pass

directorNotes.description: One-paragraph summary of the treatment strategy for this section

file.description: Absolute path to the pre-edited source section (not copied; referenced)

transcriptSrt.description: Path to the force-aligned SRT used by the Director

brand.description: RESOLVED style snapshot: brand-kit values merged over theme defaults at spec time, so a render is reproducible even if the brand kit changes later.

events.description: Graphic events only, sorted by startSec. TALKING_HEAD is the absence of an event and is never emitted.

tier.description: conversion = SUBSCRIBE_CTA / CTA_BANNER. Conversion events win contested beats and may hold screen time past their anchor beat.

cueIds.description: SRT cue numbers this event anchors to

transcript.description: The spoken words that earned this graphic. The script is the boss.

placement.description: spoken = anchored to a line in the footage; fallback = default placement used because the footage never speaks a triggering line

shot.description: From the mandatory intake shot map. Gates layout variants: 75-split and split-screen require talking-head; screen-share/b-roll beats use overlay or full-screen.

position.description: Slot for the compact conversion pills (SUBSCRIBE_CTA bottom-center, CTA_BANNER lower-third, small, ~90 percent frame height). CONCEPT_GRAPHIC uses 'layout': its variant defines the whole frame arrangement.

intent.description: The rhetorical job of this visual beat.

visualThesis.description: One sentence explaining what the viewer should notice and why this composition communicates it.

payload.description: Move-specific content. See payload shapes below.

notes.description: Why the Director chose this move for this beat

CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.variant: split-screen | 75-split | full-screen | overlay (overlay = transparent-background statement over a directional scrim, screen content stays predominant; REQUIRED choice family for screen-share/b-roll shots)
CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.zone: overlay variant only: top | center | bottom (default bottom); picked by looking at the frame for the least-busy pocket
CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.kind: statement | icon-cards | chart | steps | table | comparison | list | list-strike (statement = one big spoken claim in display type; diagram kinds for lists; plain lists are the fallback)
CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.text: statement kind only: the claim, 2 to 7 words verbatim, may contain a {COUNT} token
emphasis: statement kind: words rendered in the pop color
CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.countTo: statement kind: metric value for {COUNT}, eased 1s count-up
CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.eyebrow: small letter-spaced label above the content, optional
CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.title: optional, used mainly by full-screen

items.icon: icon keyword (pencil, person, trash, gear, doc, chart, funnel, rocket, money, link, check, x); every item should carry one
items.value: number, chart kind only: bar height + synced counter

CONCEPT_GRAPHIC.layoutNotes: split-screen: footage right ~50 / panel left ~50. 75-split: footage in rounded portrait card right ~25 over themed textured field. full-screen: themed textured background comp, footage hidden, audio continues.

SUBSCRIBE_CTA.label: SUBSCRIBE
SUBSCRIBE_CTA.clickSec: word timestamp of the spoken ask verb; the cursor click lands here while the button enters at the build-up start
SUBSCRIBE_CTA.styleNotes: compact, bottom-center, YouTube red button (functional color, overrides theme accent), themed glass bell chip, cursor click + ripple + bell wiggle animation; enters at build-up start and holds 4s+ when material allows
